ucs.title: [LLM] Conti / Wizard Spider AdFind recon → rclone-to-MEGA staging chain (pre-ransom playbook)
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Conti / FIN12 pre-encryption tradecraft: AdFind harvesting domain trusts/subnets/GPOs followed within 24h by rclone or MegaCmd exfiltration to MEGA.nz / pCloud — the exact 'steal-then-encrypt' sequence documented in the leaked Conti playbook and the leaked ContiLeaks training materials.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("adfind.exe","rclone.exe","mega.exe","megacmdshell.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*-sc trustdmp*","*-sc adinfo*","*-sc gpolist*","*-sc domainlist*","*rclone copy*","*rclone sync*","*rclone move*","*mega.nz*","*mega.co.nz*","*pcloud.com*")) by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name _time span=1s | rename Processes.* AS * | eval Phase=case(process_name="adfind.exe" OR match(process,"-sc\s+(trustdmp|adinfo|gpolist|domainlist)"),"recon", process_name IN ("rclone.exe","mega.exe","megacmdshell.exe") OR match(process,"(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|pcloud\.com|rclone\s+(copy|sync|move))"),"exfil", 1=1,"other") | where Phase!="other" | transaction host maxspan=24h startswith=(Phase="recon") endswith=(Phase="exfil") | where eventcount>=2 | table host user duration eventcount process_name process parent_process_name firstTime lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let CorrelationWindow = 24h;
let AdFindRecon = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "adfind.exe"
         or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-sc\s+(trustdmp|adinfo|gpolist|domainlist|computers_active|otrust|dcmodes)"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ReconTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ReconCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ReconParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let ExfilStaging = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","mega.exe","megacmdshell.exe")
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone copy","rclone sync","rclone move","--config","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","pcloud.com")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ExfilTime = Timestamp, ExfilDeviceId = DeviceId,
              ExfilCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ExfilBinary = FileName,
              ExfilParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
AdFindRecon
| join kind=inner ExfilStaging on $left.DeviceId == $right.ExfilDeviceId
| where ExfilTime between (ReconTime .. ReconTime + CorrelationWindow)
| extend DelayHours = datetime_diff('hour', ExfilTime, ReconTime)
| project ReconTime, ExfilTime, DelayHours, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ReconCmd, ReconParent, ExfilBinary, ExfilCmd, ExfilParent
| order by ReconTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let CorrelationWindow = 24h;
let AdFindRecon = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\adfind.exe"
         or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-sc\s+(trustdmp|adinfo|gpolist|domainlist|computers_active|otrust|dcmodes)"
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ReconTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              ReconCmd = CommandLine, ReconParent = ParentProcessName;
let ExfilStaging = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\rclone.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\mega.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\megacmdshell.exe"
         or CommandLine has_any ("rclone copy","rclone sync","rclone move","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","pcloud.com")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ExfilTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ExfilCmd = CommandLine,
              ExfilBinary = NewProcessName, ExfilParent = ParentProcessName;
AdFindRecon
| join kind=inner ExfilStaging on Computer
| where ExfilTime between (ReconTime .. ReconTime + CorrelationWindow)
| extend DelayHours = datetime_diff('hour', ExfilTime, ReconTime)
| project ReconTime, ExfilTime, DelayHours, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          ReconCmd, ReconParent, ExfilBinary, ExfilCmd, ExfilParent
| order by ReconTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\adfind.exe OR *\\AdFind.exe OR *\\ADFIND.EXE OR *\\rclone.exe OR *\\Rclone.exe OR *\\RCLONE.EXE OR *\\mega.exe OR *\\Mega.exe OR *\\megacmdshell.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"-sc trustdmp"* OR *"-sc adinfo"* OR *"-sc gpolist"* OR *"-sc domainlist"* OR *"rclone copy"* OR *"rclone sync"* OR *"rclone move"* OR *"mega.nz"* OR *"mega.co.nz"* OR *"pcloud.com"*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\(adfind|rclone|mega|megacmdshell)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/-sc\s+(trustdmp|adinfo|gpolist|domainlist|computers_active|otrust|dcmodes)/i OR CommandLine=/(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|pcloud\.com|rclone\s+(copy|sync|move))/i)
| Phase := if(regex("\\\\adfind\\.exe$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false) OR regex("-sc\\s+(trustdmp|adinfo|gpolist|domainlist)", field=CommandLine, strict=false), "recon", "exfil")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen), count(field=Phase, distinct=true, as=DistinctPhases), collect([Phase, ImageFileName, CommandLine, UserName])])
| DistinctPhases >= 2
ucs.rationale: AdFind with the trustdmp/adinfo/gpolist switches is the verbatim recon command set published in the ContiLeaks training docs and the Aug-2021 leaked Conti playbook (the same one IBM X-Force, Mandiant and DFIR Report all reproduced). Rclone-to-MEGA / pCloud is Conti / FIN12 / UNC1878's signature exfil channel — they reused the same rclone.conf format across dozens of intrusions. AdFind alone is noi

ucs.title: [LLM] Conti / Wizard Spider pre-encryption recovery-inhibition cluster (vssadmin + bcdedit + wbadmin + wmic shadowcopy)
ucs.description: Detects the multi-binary recovery-inhibition burst Conti's locker (and its earlier Ryuk lineage) executes seconds before file encryption — a signature 4-call sequence baked into the Conti builder leaked in Feb-2022. Requires 2+ distinct inhibit-recovery binaries from the cluster within a 10-minute window on the same host to fire.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe") AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*resize shadowstorage*" OR (Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled No*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*delete systemstatebackup*" OR Processes.process="*delete backup*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name _time span=1s | rename Processes.* AS * | eval InhibitKind=case(process_name="vssadmin.exe","vss-delete", process_name="wmic.exe","wmic-shadowcopy", process_name="bcdedit.exe","bcd-disable-recovery", process_name="wbadmin.exe","wbadmin-delete", 1=1,"other") | search NOT user="*$" | bin _time span=10m as bucket | stats min(_time) as FirstSeen max(_time) as LastSeen dc(InhibitKind) as DistinctTechniques values(InhibitKind) as Techniques values(process) as Cmds values(parent_process_name) as Parents by host user bucket | where DistinctTechniques>=2 | sort - FirstSeen
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let Window = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","recoveryenabled no","recoveryenabled No"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup","delete backup"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend InhibitKind = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe", "vss-delete",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe",     "wmic-shadowcopy",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe",  "bcd-disable-recovery",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe",  "wbadmin-delete",
    "other")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctTechniques = dcount(InhibitKind),
            Techniques = make_set(InhibitKind),
            CmdSample  = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Parents    = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 6),
            Users      = make_set(AccountName, 4)
            by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where DistinctTechniques >= 2     // 2+ distinct inhibit-recovery binaries within 10m on one host = Conti locker fingerprint
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:

     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup","delete backup"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend InhibitKind = case(
    NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe", "vss-delete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe",     "wmic-shadowcopy",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe",  "bcd-disable-recovery",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe",  "wbadmin-delete",
    "other")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),

            Techniques = make_set(InhibitKind),

            Parents    = make_set(ParentProcessName, 6),
            Users      = make_set(SubjectUserName, 4)
            by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)

| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Conti / Wizard Spider Pre-Encryption Recovery Inhibition Cluster
id: 9c1d3f8a-conti-inhibit-recovery
status: experimental
description: Detects the multi-binary recovery-inhibition burst (vssadmin / bcdedit / wbadmin / wmic shadowcopy) baked into the leaked Conti locker builder and the predecessor Ryuk lineage (G0102 / Wizard Spider).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1490/
  - https://thedfirreport.com/category/ransomware/conti/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
  - attack.g0102
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  vssadmin_delete:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete shadows'
      - 'resize shadowstorage'
  bcdedit_disable_recovery:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
  wbadmin_delete:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete catalog'
      - 'delete systemstatebackup'
      - 'delete backup'
  wmic_shadowcopy:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  condition: 1 of vssadmin_delete or 1 of bcdedit_disable_recovery or 1 of wbadmin_delete or 1 of wmic_shadowcopy
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned backup-software maintenance (extremely rare for these exact argument combinations)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"resize shadowstorage"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BcdEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"recoveryenabled No"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"delete systemstatebackup"* OR *"delete backup"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* AND *delete*))) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ((ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(delete\s+shadows|resize\s+shadowstorage)/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no)/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup|backup)/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy.*delete/i))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| InhibitKind := if(regex("\\\\vssadmin\\.exe$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false), "vss-delete", if(regex("\\\\bcdedit\\.exe$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false), "bcd-disable-recovery", if(regex("\\\\wbadmin\\.exe$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false), "wbadmin-delete", "wmic-shadowcopy")))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen), count(field=InhibitKind, distinct=true, as=DistinctTechniques), collect([InhibitKind, CommandLine, UserName])])
| DistinctTechniques >= 2
ucs.rationale: Conti's locker (analysed from the leaked Feb-2022 builder) runs an embedded sequence: vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet → vssadmin resize shadowstorage → wmic shadowcopy delete → bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures → bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled no → wbadmin delete catalog -quiet. Single-binary alerts on vssadmin/bcdedit fire on legitimate admin work; requiring 2+
